title: Traffic steward for staged variants and Bayesian safeguard
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We need a reproducible, low-friction way to run staged model upgrades that balances rapid discovery of regressions with minimizing user exposure. Current rollouts rely on static percentage splits and heuristic monitors that surface noisy signals too late.

Goal: Build a Traffic Steward service and Console UX that orchestrates staged variants with: budgeted exposure ramps, cohort-aware throttling, intermittent shadowing for signal collection, and a Bayesian early-signal engine that recommends or triggers auto-rollback. The feature should be safe by default, observable in Console, and usable by both hosted and Dedicated customers.

Scope: experiment setup APIs, runtime routing hooks, exposure scheduling, statistical checks (Bayesian posterior checks + sequential hypothesis rules), rollback policy definitions, replay/simulate mode, and dashboarding for signals and decisions. Integrations: Redwood runtime routing, Console rollouts UI, Optimize recommendations, and audit logs for Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: API: POST /experiments creates a rollout with parameters: variant set, exposure budget, cohorts, schedule, shadow rules, and rollback thresholds
Exposure control: rollout can ramp from 0% to target using budgeted steps, and can apply per-cohort throttling (e.g., 1% -> 5% -> 20% over N hours)
Shadowing: ability to route mirrored requests to new variant for X% of traffic without impacting responses, with collected signal stored in evaluation topic

Statistical checks: Bayesian decision engine computes posterior distributions for primary metrics (latency, quality delta, safety) and produces P(stop) and recommended action; console surfaces these with confidence intervals

Auto-rollback: if Bayesian engine crosses configured risk threshold AND secondary safety triggers (e.g., toxicity spike) are present, system automatically reduces exposure to 0% and records audit entry
Simulation: operators can run 'replay' against historical traffic to validate rollout plan and view expected decisions before live launch
Observability: rollout dashboard shows exposure timeline, per-cohort metric deltas, posterior plots, decision log, and link to supporting logs and PRs
Permissions & audit: only roles with rollout-write can start/abort experiments; all auto-decisions create signed audit events stored via Private audit pipeline
Backward compatibility: existing simple percent-based rollouts continue to work; Traffic Steward is an opt-in advanced controller
Tests: end-to-end integration test with runtime that simulates a regression and validates auto-rollback within configured SLO window
implementation_notes: Components: Traffic Steward control-plane (service), Bayesian Decision Engine (stateless service reading metrics), Runtime routing hook (SDK/runtime change), Console UX extension, Replay harness
Data flows: mirrored requests written to evaluation Kafka topic; metrics pipeline computes per-variant aggregates and exposes them to Decision Engine via time-series API

Decision logic: use conjugate priors for rate/ratio metrics, Gaussian or empirical-Bayes for continuous metrics; support sequential probability ratio test (SPRT) and Bayesian credible interval based stops
Exposure budget: define both absolute request counts and time-windowed percentages; allow emergency circuit-breakers per region/model
Rollback policy: soft rollback (reduce to next lower step) and hard rollback (0% + notify); allow 'dry-run' and 'auto' modes
Console: new 'Steward' rollout wizard with preset templates (canary, progressive cohort, shadow-first), and JSON export/import for infra-as-code
Security: Integrate with KMS for audit event signing in Private deployments; ensure PII is redacted from mirrored payloads by default
Performance: Bayesian engine must evaluate rules within 30s of ingestion window; keep decision service horizontally scalable
Compatibility: work with both hosted models and Dedicated pools; routing hook must gracefully fallback to compatible variant when capacity is constrained
Operational runbook: include playbook for false positives, how to pause steward, and rollback verification checklist
